PURPOSE: Does observable runtime state predict when invoking CERTIFIED_MEMORY_V1 (configs/certified_memory_v1.json) beats answering directly? This is an OPPORTUNITY STUDY, not controller training -- it exists to establish, before any controller is built, whether there is a real, statistically-supported, operationally-meaningful gap between the oracle per-task action choice and the best single fixed policy.
MEMORY_OPERATION_IS_FROZEN: The memory action (E1/A1) invokes CERTIFIED_MEMORY_V1 exactly as confirmed -- hrm_adaptive_memory.experiment_integrity.certified_memory.assert_certified_memory_v1_unchanged() is called before every use and this run aborts (fail-closed) on any mismatch. This study may not alter retrieval, graph construction, path ranking, the composer's contract, or packet_budget=6. If a controller-development need to change the memory operation arises later, that requires freezing CERTIFIED_MEMORY_V2 and re-confirming it BEFORE it may be used in any executive study.

DATASET.role: calibration (development-tier, per hrm_adaptive_memory.experiment_integrity.split_lineage.SplitRole.CALIBRATION) -- explicitly NOT g2_confirmation_2, which is consumed and diagnosis_only. Reusing calibration data for this NEW question (is there action-value heterogeneity at all?) is the same tier of use HRM qualification itself made of this suite: a development/qualification-grade study, not a final confirmation claim. An untouched confirmation split for the executive layer, if this study passes, is a SEPARATE future gate -- not built yet, not named, not touched by this study.

A0_ANSWER_NOW.definition: HRM answers with an EMPTY evidence packet -- selection.selected_ids=() through the unmodified run_packet_stage/compose_evidence_prompt path, which already renders '[NO EXTERNAL EVIDENCE]' when contents is empty (byte-identical to the Gate A composer, parity-tested). No new prompt format invented; this reuses the existing frozen composer exactly.
A0_ANSWER_NOW.cost: zero retrieval, zero graph construction, zero composition -- the cheap default action

A1_USE_CERTIFIED_MEMORY.definition: Exactly H2_g2_pathcoherent from qualification/confirmation-2: C2 retrieval -> G2 graph -> frozen path ranking -> path-coherent packet composer -> packet_budget=6, gated by assert_certified_memory_v1_unchanged().
A1_USE_CERTIFIED_MEMORY.cost: retrieval + graph + composition, then HRM generation over a 6-record packet

UTILITY_V1: U(a) = Q(a) (quality/correctness only -- token/latency/compute cost terms deferred to a later utility version once opportunity is established, per research-lead directive to start with the cleanest falsifiable question)
ORACLE_TIE_BREAK: If Q(A0)==Q(A1) for a task, the oracle (E3) picks A0_ANSWER_NOW -- the cheaper action wins ties. Frozen before any task is scored; prevents a memory-favoring tie-break from inflating the oracle's apparent advantage.

POLICY_LADDER.E2: simple FIXED heuristic, defined and frozen below BEFORE any task is scored
POLICY_LADDER.E3: oracle per-task choice -- U(E3) = mean_i max(Q(A0_i), Q(A1_i)), tie-break A0

E2_FROZEN_HEURISTIC.rule: USE_CERTIFIED_MEMORY iff (identity_status in {EXACT, RESOLVED}) AND (n_complete_paths >= 1); else ANSWER_NOW.
E2_FROZEN_HEURISTIC.rationale: Both conditions are the cheapest, most structurally obvious pre-generation signals that the memory pipeline has ANYTHING coherent to offer: an unresolved identity means the retrieval/graph stage has no canonical subject to anchor on, and zero complete paths means the composer has no complete evidence chain to hand HRM regardless of packet_budget. This is a naive necessary-condition gate, not a learned rule -- it exists so E3's oracle ceiling is compared against something better than the two degenerate always-X policies, without smuggling in anything resembling a trained controller.
E2_FROZEN_HEURISTIC.computed_from: identity_status (run_identity_stage), n_complete_paths (len([p for p in g2_prefilter(...).all_paths if p.complete])) -- both already computed as part of building the A1 packet, no extra pipeline calls needed, no evaluator truth involved.

PRIMARY_METRIC.name: ExecutiveOpportunity
PRIMARY_METRIC.reading: The utility available purely from choosing the right action per task, above whatever the best SINGLE fixed policy already achieves. This is the ceiling a controller could ever capture -- if it is small or unreliable, training a controller is not worth it yet.

FROZEN_PROMOTION_CRITERIA.margin_rationale: 5 percentage points of quality. Smaller than this, the complexity/risk of building and deploying a learned executive is not obviously justified over just picking the better fixed policy. This is a considered, frozen judgment call (analogous to the 0.03 HRM qualification margin, which was reasoned relative to C4's PRIMARY_DELTA_THRESHOLD=0.15) -- NOT re-derived from this study's own data.
FROZEN_PROMOTION_CRITERIA.lcb_method: grouped_lcb_executive_opportunity (scripts/run_executive_opportunity_study.py) -- a generalization of scripts/diagnose_c5_confirmation_stopgate.grouped_lcb to a compound (max-based) per-replicate statistic instead of a simple paired mean, using the SAME resampling convention (resample by family group with replacement, not by task; seed=12345, iterations=2000) so the two are methodologically consistent even though grouped_lcb itself cannot express a max() term.

action_diversity_requirement.rule: Both A0 and A1 must each account for >= 15% of E3's oracle per-task choices.
action_diversity_requirement.rationale: If one action captures >85% of oracle picks, ExecutiveOpportunity may be technically positive but operationally useless -- there is little a controller could learn beyond a trivial always-X rule. This is the exact failure mode the research-lead directive named explicitly (a 99%-memory oracle). 15% is a frozen, non-tuned threshold chosen before this run for the same reason as the margin above: symmetric, not favoring either action, and well above 'a handful of edge-case tasks.'

FROZEN_PROMOTION_CRITERIA.promoted_iff: ExecutiveOpportunity >= 0.05 AND LCB_2.5% > 0.0 AND both actions >= 15% of oracle picks

STATE_FEATURES_CAPTURED_NOT_USED_AS_DECI.purpose: Recorded per task in every receipt for a FUTURE Executive v1 to learn from -- NOT read by this study's own oracle/heuristic/metric computation beyond the two named fields in E2_FROZEN_HEURISTIC. Evaluator truth (task correctness, the answer string) is never a feature.
features: graph_reachability (fraction of candidate pool with >=1 incident edge)
bridge_availability_estimate (bool: >=1 bridge record in working set)
terminal_availability_estimate (bool: >=1 terminal record in working set)
cost_already_spent (A0's own token/latency, as a proxy -- meaningful once utility includes cost terms)
STATE_FEATURES_CAPTURED_NOT_USED_AS_DECI.hard_rule: If Executive v1 is ever trained, its input features are restricted to this frozen list (pre-generation, non-evaluator state only). Adding a feature later requires updating this list explicitly, not silently expanding what a controller sees.

PROCESSING_ORDER: 1. RUN_VALID: both actions scored for every task, hash chain intact (A1 uses the same hash chain as confirmation-2, A0's packet_hash/prompt_hash computed identically over an empty packet), CERTIFIED_MEMORY_V1 assertion held for every A1 invocation, prompt binding held for every generation.
2. Compute U(E0), U(E1), U(E2), U(E3), ExecutiveOpportunity.
3. Apply FROZEN_PROMOTION_CRITERIA (margin, LCB, action diversity) exactly as specified above -- no threshold tuned after seeing the result.
4. Freeze the verdict before any feature-vs-outcome inspection.

5. Only if promoted: proceed to state-feature-vs-DeltaU diagnostic inspection (the LAST step, per research-lead directive: 'examine which runtime-visible state features explain the difference' happens only after opportunity is established, never before).

VERDICT_NAMING.if_promoted: EXECUTIVE_OPPORTUNITY_CONFIRMED -- proceed to design Executive v0 (two actions only: ANSWER_NOW, USE_CERTIFIED_MEMORY) trained to predict U-hat(a|state) from the frozen feature list, benchmarked against E0/E1/E2/E3 exactly as specified in the research-lead directive.
VERDICT_NAMING.if_not_promoted: NO_EXECUTIVE_OPPORTUNITY -- do not train a controller. If ExecutiveOpportunity is small/unreliable but one fixed policy (E0 or E1) clearly dominates, promote that fixed policy as the default action and stop -- this is itself a valid, useful finding, not a failure requiring further tuning of this study's thresholds.
VERDICT_NAMING.if_low_diversity: EXPANSION_NOT_WARRANTED -- even if the margin/LCB pass, if action diversity fails, treat as NO_EXECUTIVE_OPPORTUNITY: the oracle's near-total preference for one action means a controller has nothing meaningful to route.
